The '''Deep Ocean''' was a [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] that was home to [[Mahara Kesh]], the [[Je'daii Temples|Temple]] of Healing for the [[Je'daii Order]].<ref name="DOTJ 0" /> In [[36,453 BBY]], one of the [[Tho Yor]] pyramid [[Starship/Legends|ships]] brought [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] pilgrims to the Deep Ocean and settled into the waters, and over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] the pilgrims&mdash;who formed the Je'daii Order&mdash;built Mahara Kesh around the Tho Yor. Squid-like creatures, wide-mouthed eel-like [[Fish/Legends|fish]], and several other [[Species/Legends|species]] of smaller fish were among the creatures that inhabited the Deep Ocean.<ref name="DOTJ 5">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 5]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Deep Ocean was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|preview issue 0]] for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'',<ref name="DOTJ 0" /> and it later first appeared in the series' fifth issue [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 5]].<ref name="DOTJ 5" />
